name: claude-session-skill
description: Search, browse, and resume past Claude Code sessions with AI-generated summaries — plus an MCP server for any MCP-compatible client
author: ITeachYouAI <engineering@iteachyouai.com>

scripts.build: bun build session.ts --outdir dist --target node && bun build mcp-server.ts --outdir dist --target node && node -e "const fs=require('fs');['dist/session.js','dist/mcp-server.js'].forEach(f=>{const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!c.startsWith('#!'))fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c);fs.chmodSync(f,0o755)})"
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun test && bun run typecheck && bun run build
